_comment: The player-summoned fire totem (2026-07-21): a stationary aura carrier created only by the FireTotem spawn effect (never referenced by any zone spawn) — Totem precedent. collisionLayer 160 = Viewport|Player (the player-layer trick: hostile enemy-masks can hit it; ally auras buff it), collisionMask 16 = Border only (non-blocking, nothing pushes it). role structure = its aura is always-on and it authors no aggroRadius; speed 0 = it never moves. A structure WITH an owner — role and ownership are orthogonal (chunk 2). Slightly beefier than the plain Totem (60 vs 50) because it is a late-game drop that plants itself in a fight it wants to survive. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
name: FireTotem
